zones.title: Input
zones.body: Called by Daily and Backfill with {run_id, as_of, tickers[], start, end}.

zones.title: Fetch: Alpaca daily bars
zones.body: One request for every ticker (SIP feed, split-adjusted). The free plan refuses SIP data newer than 15 min, so an end date of today is capped at now minus 16 min. Follows next_page_token until the page is empty, 3 retries on failure. Credential: Stock Intel Alpaca (headers).

zones.title: Normalize + store
zones.body:
Pages become one row per (ticker, date), upserted into intel.prices_daily in a single jsonb transaction, plus one intel.api_usage row.
Lower row: the error output logs status=error and returns ok=false so the caller keeps going.
